caption: A strip of packing tape is ripped off a cardboard box and the box flaps come free.

sa.check: A cardboard box is sealed with a strip of packing tape.
The rip comes first and the flaps follow.

pc.expect: The tape peels up along its length as it is pulled, sometimes taking the top layer of cardboard with it.
pc.fail: The tape shatters; or it stretches long like rubber; or it lifts off all at once with no pull.

pc.expect: The flaps open only after the tape is off.
pc.fail: The flaps open with the tape still on; or the tape is off and the flaps stay sealed; or the flaps open before the pull.
It slides; or lifts; or jumps.

pc.expect: The tape stays one strip and the box stays one box.
pc.fail: The tape vanishes; or it regrows on the box; or the box splits.

pc.expect: One box keeps its number, and the hands do not pass through it.
pc.fail: The hands pass through the box; or a second box appears; or the box turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The box's printing and the tape's colour stay the same.
pc.fail: The printing changes; or the tape changes colour; or the room rearranges.
